sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Select paper, title and absorption coefficient value with unit
SELECT ?paper ?title ?numericValue ?unitLabel
WHERE {
  # Reach the OpticalProperties contribution instance
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P161031 ?hop1 .
  ?hop1 orkgp:P161034 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C117033 .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?title .
  # AbsorptionCoefficient predicate
  ?contribution orkgp:P161026 ?absNode .
  # Quantity value -> numeric value
  ?absNode orkgp:P45073 ?qv .
  ?qv orkgp:P45075 ?numericValue .
  # Unit
  OPTIONAL { ?qv orkgp:P45076 ?unit . ?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?title

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# Select paper, title, evaluation resource, metric label, numeric value and unit
SELECT ?paper ?title ?evaluation ?metricLabel ?numericValue ?unitLabel
WHERE {
  # Reach the Retrieval system contribution instance
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C77004 .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?title .
  # Evaluation predicate
  ?contribution orkgp:P34 ?evaluation .
  # Metric nested under evaluation
  OPTIONAL { ?evaluation orkgp:HAS_METRIC ?metric . ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel }
  # Value nested under evaluation -> numeric value and unit
  OPTIONAL { ?evaluation orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value . ?value orkgp:P45075 ?numericValue . OPTIONAL { ?value orkgp:P45076 ?unit . ?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel } }
}
ORDER BY ?title

# Select paper, title and reference publication value/label
SELECT ?paper ?title ?referencePublication ?referencePublicationLabel
WHERE {
  # Reach the SemTab challenge contribution instance via paper contribution and section predicates
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  { ?paperContribution orkgp:P15370 ?contribution . } UNION { ?paperContribution orkgp:P97167 ?contribution . }

  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?title .
  # reference publication predicate
  ?contribution orkgp:P49053 ?referencePublication .
  # Optional label of the reference publication resource
  OPTIONAL { ?referencePublication rdfs:label ?referencePublicationLabel }
}
